description.value: The Deeley Motorcycle Exhibition houses Canada's largest privately-owned collection of vintage motorcycles, spanning over 100 years of motorcycling history with machines of all makes and models from Trev Deeley's personal collection. The Deeley family's commercial roots go back to 1914 when Fred Deeley originally sold bicycles before pivoting to motorcycles, giving the venue an interesting connection to two-wheeled transport history. Located just off Highway 1 on the Vancouver/Burnaby border with free onsite parking, it offers an interactive exhibit where visitors can sit on a display bike for photos.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loads and confirms the business is an active motorcycle museum and event venue at 1875 Boundary Road, Vancouver, BC V5M 3Y7, with phone (604) 293-2221 matching OSM. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.—are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all amenity fields remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule. The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the address and website clearly place the venue on the Vancouver/Burnaby border, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the venue's confirmed address (1875 Boundary Road, Vancouver, BC V5M 3Y7) is on the Vancouver/Burnaby border — not North Vancouver. OSM community tag should be corrected.
OSM record has no address field populated; address was sourced from the website's contact and location pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating tourist attraction with broad appeal to cycling enthusiasts given its motorcycle and bicycle heritage; the Deeley family's cycling origins and the museum's free-admission-by-donation model make it a worthwhile stop on a touring route through Metro Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Entry is by donation. The adjacent Trev Deeley Harley-Davidson showroom is a separate business sharing the same property. None of the required WWC amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from website content — an in-person verification visit is recommended before publishing a full listing.

wow_evidence: Canada's largest private vintage motorcycle collection (widely cited), 100+ years of machines; Deeley's 1914 bicycle-shop roots add cyclist interest. Genuine niche museum.
blurb: Canada's largest private vintage motorcycle collection; the Deeleys sold bicycles first, from 1914.
